app.name: DClaw Onboard
app.tagline: Automated employee onboarding — powered by AI
app.description: A complete onboarding suite that transforms how companies welcome new hires. From AI-guided journeys to automated document collection, DClaw Onboard covers every step of the employee's first 90 days.

features.name: AI Onboarding Copilot
features.description: AI-powered virtual buddy that guides new hires through their first 30/60/90 days. Answers questions, reminds of tasks, and surfaces resources proactively.

hero.headline: Never Let a New Hire Feel Lost Again
hero.subheadline: Buddy Bot provides 24/7 AI-powered guidance — answering questions, sending nudges, and generating personalized onboarding plans in under 2 minutes.

items.title: RAG-Powered Q&A
items.description: Answers new-hire questions by searching company wiki, policies, and onboarding docs in real time. No more digging through shared drives.

items.title: Proactive Nudges
items.description: Sends timely reminders for pending tasks, upcoming 1:1s, and training deadlines. Keeps new hires on track without manager intervention.

items.title: Personalized 30/60/90 Plans
items.description: Generates role-specific onboarding plans with milestones, learning resources, and check-in points — all tailored by seniority and department.

items.title: Multi-Channel Access
items.description: Available as a floating chat widget on every page plus daily digest cards in the new-hire portal. Always one click away.

items.title: Sentiment-Aware Responses
items.description: Detects confusion or frustration in new-hire messages and escalates to a human buddy or manager when needed.

items.title: Local-First AI
items.description: Falls back to local Ollama models when cloud AI is unavailable. Zero downtime, always responsive.

items.label: AI Stack
items.value: RAG + OpenRouter Kimi K2.5 + Ollama fallback

features.name: Journey Builder & Checklists
features.description: Visual builder for onboarding journeys with tasks, deadlines, dependencies, and role-based paths. Drag-and-drop interface with real-time progress tracking.

hero.headline: Design Onboarding Journeys That Work
hero.subheadline: Build role-specific onboarding paths with visual drag-and-drop tools. Set deadlines, define dependencies, and watch new hires progress in real time.

items.title: Visual Drag-and-Drop Builder
items.description: Create onboarding journeys by dragging task cards onto a timeline. Reorder, group, and connect tasks with dependency arrows.

items.title: Role-Based Templates
items.description: Start from 50+ pre-built templates for roles like Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Executive. Customize or build from scratch.

items.title: Task Dependencies
items.description: Define logical dependencies between tasks. Complete IT setup before tool training. Finish compliance before system access.

items.title: Progress Tracking
items.description: Real-time progress bars for each new hire. See at a glance who's ahead, on track, or falling behind.

items.title: Auto-Assign Owners
items.description: Each task auto-assigns to the right person — manager, buddy, IT, or the new hire themselves.

items.title: Deadline Automation
items.description: Set relative deadlines (Day 1, Day 7, Day 30) that auto-calculate from the new hire's start date.

items.label: Average time to customize a journey
Backend Engine
items.value: Journey template engine with task dependency graph

features.name: Document Collection & E-Sign
features.description: Auto-request documents (ID, tax forms, contracts). Track completion with visual checklist. Built-in e-signature integration for policy acknowledgments.

hero.headline: Collect Documents Without the Chase
hero.subheadline: Automate the entire document collection workflow — from request to verification. Support 10+ document types with built-in e-signature and compliance validation.

items.title: Auto-Request Workflow
items.description: Automatically request I-9, W-4, direct deposit, and policy acknowledgments based on role and location. No manual follow-ups.

items.title: Visual Document Checklist
items.description: New hires see a clear checklist with status indicators. Upload widgets for each document type with drag-and-drop support.

items.title: E-Signature Integration
items.description: Built-in electronic signature for offer letters, NDAs, and policy acknowledgments. Legally binding and audit-trailed.

items.title: AI Document Validation
items.description: Automatically checks uploaded documents for completeness, legibility, and expiration dates. Flags issues before HR review.

items.title: Compliance Tracking
items.description: Track I-9 verification status, tax form completion, and policy sign-offs. Audit-ready reports at your fingertips.

items.title: Reminder Automation
items.description: Gentle, escalating reminders for overdue documents. Escalates to manager after 3 nudges with no response.

items.label: Average time to full document completion
Storage
items.value: MinIO object storage with encryption at rest

features.name: Stakeholder Introductions
features.description: Auto-schedule 1:1s with key team members. Generate AI-powered intro briefs for each meeting so new hires walk in prepared and connected.

hero.headline: First Impressions Are Everything
hero.subheadline: Auto-schedule coffee chats and 1:1s with the people who matter. Each meeting comes with an AI-generated intro brief — Meet Sarah, your design lead. She joined in 2019...

items.title: Auto-Schedule 1:1s
items.description: Intelligently schedules introductions with managers, buddies, team leads, and key cross-functional partners based on the new hire's role.

items.title: AI-Generated Intro Briefs
items.description: For each meeting, Buddy Bot generates a brief: who they're meeting, their background, what they do, and suggested talking points.

items.title: Org Chart Integration
items.description: Automatically maps the new hire's reporting chain, skip-level, and key collaborators. No org-chart archaeology required.

items.title: Meeting Context Cards
items.description: Digital cards for each introduction with photo, bio, fun facts, and discussion topics. Reviewable on mobile before walking into the room.

items.title: Coffee Chat Roulette
items.description: Optional random pairing with colleagues outside their immediate team. Builds cross-functional relationships from day one.

items.title: Calendar Integration
items.description: Direct integration with Google Calendar and Outlook. Meetings appear with full context in the calendar invite body.

features.name: Equipment & Access Provisioning
features.description: IT equipment requests, software license provisioning, and access group assignments — all automated from the moment an offer is accepted.

hero.headline: Day-One Ready, Every Time
hero.subheadline: Laptop configured. Accounts provisioned. Software licenses activated. All before the new hire walks through the door.

items.title: Equipment Catalog
items.description: Browse and request from a catalog of standardized equipment — laptops, monitors, peripherals — with role-based defaults.

items.title: Auto-Provisioning
items.description: Automatically create accounts in Okta/Azure AD, assign to correct groups, and provision SaaS licenses based on role.

items.title: IT Ticket Automation
items.description: Generates IT tickets with full context — employee details, start date, equipment list, and shipping address.

items.title: Shipment Tracking
items.description: Track equipment shipments from warehouse to new hire's doorstep. Real-time status updates for HR and IT teams.

features.name: Culture & Values Integration
features.description: Interactive culture modules, values quizzes, team stories, and social connection prompts that immerse new hires in company culture.

hero.headline: Culture Isn't a Handbook — It's an Experience
hero.subheadline: From interactive values quizzes to coffee chat roulette, make your company culture come alive for every new team member.

items.title: Interactive Culture Modules
items.description: Bite-sized, engaging modules that teach company history, values, and mission — not a 50-page PDF nobody reads.

items.title: Values Quizzes
items.description: Fun, low-stakes quizzes that reinforce company values through real scenarios and team stories.

items.title: Team Stories & Spotlights
items.description: Video and written spotlights featuring team members sharing their favorite projects, traditions, and advice.

items.title: Social Connection Prompts
items.description: AI-suggested conversation starters and team activities based on shared interests and complementary skills.

features.name: Manager Dashboard & Alerts
features.description: Manager view of all direct report onboarding progress. Smart alerts flag stalled journeys and at-risk new hires before it's too late.

hero.headline: Know Exactly How Your People Are Doing
hero.subheadline: One dashboard. All your direct reports. Real-time progress bars, sentiment scores, and smart alerts that tell you who needs help.

items.title: Unified Progress View
items.description: See every direct report's onboarding progress in one view — checklist completion, document status, training progress.

items.title: Risk Flagging
items.description: AI analyzes engagement patterns and flags new hires who may be struggling — before they disengage or leave.

items.title: Smart Alerts
items.description: Configurable alerts for stalled journeys, missed deadlines, and low sentiment scores. Push, email, or Slack notifications.

items.title: Intervention Suggestions
items.description: When a new hire is flagged, the AI suggests concrete actions — schedule a check-in, assign a buddy, adjust the plan.

items.title: Weekly Digest Reports
items.description: Automated weekly summary of team onboarding status — who's on track, who needs attention, and key milestones reached.

items.title: Sentiment Trends
items.description: Track new-hire sentiment over time from pulse surveys. Spot downward trends and act before they become problems.

items.label: Average response time to risk flags

features.name: Feedback & Pulse Checks
features.description: Micro-surveys at day 7, 30, 60, and 90. Sentiment tracking with AI-powered theme detection and actionable insights.

hero.headline: Listen Before It's Too Late
hero.subheadline: Micro-surveys at key milestones capture how new hires really feel. AI surfaces themes and trends so you can act fast.

items.title: Scheduled Micro-Surveys
items.description: Auto-delivered surveys at Day 7, 30, 60, and 90. Short, focused, and mobile-friendly — takes 2 minutes to complete.

items.title: Sentiment Analysis
items.description: AI analyzes open-ended responses for sentiment, themes, and concerns. Quantifies the qualitative for trend detection.

items.title: Theme Detection
items.description: Automatically groups feedback into themes — culture fit, role clarity, tool frustration, team dynamics — with trend lines.

items.title: Actionable Insights
items.description: Surfaces concrete, prioritized recommendations based on feedback patterns — not just raw data, but what to do about it.

items.label: Time to complete a pulse survey

features.name: AI-Generated Learning Paths
features.description: Curate and generate personalized learning content for each role using AI. Auto-enroll in relevant courses from DClaw Learn.

hero.headline: Every Role Deserves a Custom Curriculum
hero.subheadline: AI analyzes the role, seniority, and skill gaps to generate a personalized learning path — with auto-enrollment in DClaw Learn courses.

items.title: Role-Based Curriculum
items.description: AI maps required skills for each role to available training content, creating a structured learning journey from day one.

items.title: Gap Analysis
items.description: Identifies skill gaps based on role requirements and new hire background. Prioritizes what to learn first.

items.title: Auto-Enrollment
items.description: Automatically enrolls new hires in DClaw Learn courses. Tracks completion and sends smart reminders.

items.title: Progress Tracking
items.description: Visual progress tracking for each learning path. Managers can see which courses are completed and which are pending.

features.name: Gamification & Achievements
features.description: Make onboarding fun with badges, progress celebrations, team leaderboards, and achievement unlocks.

hero.headline: Onboarding Should Be Celebrated, Not Dreaded
hero.subheadline: Turn onboarding milestones into moments of celebration. Badges, leaderboards, and team shoutouts keep new hires engaged and motivated.

items.title: Achievement Badges
items.description: Earn badges for completing milestones — First Week Done, Document Pro, Culture Champion, Social Butterfly, and more.

items.title: Progress Celebrations
items.description: Confetti animations and congratulatory messages when new hires hit key milestones. Shareable to team channels.

items.title: Team Leaderboards
items.description: Friendly competition with team-based leaderboards for onboarding completion. Drives engagement through positive peer pressure.

items.title: Milestone Unlocks
items.description: Unlock new features, resources, or perks as onboarding progresses. Creates a sense of progression and discovery.

features.name: Pre-Boarding
features.description: Engage candidates between offer acceptance and Day 1. Reduce ghosting with pre-start content, team teasers, and first-day prep.

hero.headline: The Gap Between 'Yes' and Day 1 Is Critical
hero.subheadline: Keep new hires warm between offer acceptance and their start date. Pre-boarding engagement reduces ghosting by up to 50%.

items.title: Pre-Start Engagement
items.description: Share company swag, team photos, and welcome messages the moment an offer is accepted. Build excitement before day one.

items.title: First-Day Prep
items.description: Send logistics info — where to go, what to bring, dress code, parking — so new hires feel prepared and confident.

items.title: Team Teasers
items.description: Share fun profiles of team members they'll work with. Build familiarity and reduce first-day anxiety.

items.title: Ghosting Prevention
items.description: Engagement tracking and smart re-engagement campaigns. AI detects disengagement patterns and triggers personalized outreach.

features.name: Offboarding Companion
features.description: Smooth handoff to offboarding module for departing employees. Knowledge transfer, exit surveys, and alumni network integration.

hero.headline: Great Goodbyes Lead to Great Alumni
hero.subheadline: Handle departures with the same care as arrivals. Structured offboarding preserves knowledge, gathers feedback, and builds your alumni network.

items.title: Knowledge Transfer
items.description: Structured workflows to capture and document critical knowledge before departure. Auto-assigns KT sessions with team members.

items.title: Exit Surveys
items.description: Comprehensive exit surveys with AI-powered theme analysis. Understand why people leave and what to improve.

items.title: Access Revocation
items.description: Automated access revocation across all systems. One-click deprovisioning that leaves no loose ends.

items.title: Alumni Network
items.description: Keep departed employees in your orbit. Alumni portal with networking, job board, and company updates.
